inputs.text: The “No Kings” rally turning volatile after federal officers arrived with tear gas and arrests looks less like an accident than a ready-made story: provoke disorder, then blame the protesters as “agitators.” At least 13 arrests were confirmed, but that number doesn’t answer who benefits. The chaos gives officials a reason to shift attention from the anti-Trump protest to control of the streets—and I don’t buy that this framing is neutral.
